title: Putin's Gambit Unravels: The Dangerous Desperation of a Cornered Kremlin
summary: Vladimir Putin's 'special military operation' in Ukraine, intended for a swift victory, has devolved into a protracted and costly quagmire, marking a profound strategic failure. This deepening desperation within the Kremlin could prompt unpredictable and dangerous actions, raising significant concerns for global stability.
content:
The "special military operation" launched by Moscow in early 2022, initially conceived as a lightning strike to install a pliant regime in Kyiv within days, has instead morphed into a grinding, protracted quagmire. Now well into 2026, the conflict has surpassed even the Soviet Union's nine-year entanglement in Afghanistan in its duration and strategic miscalculation, leaving Russian President Vladimir Putin facing an increasingly perilous reality. The tide has undeniably turned, leaving Russia isolated and its military reputation tarnished.

This dramatic reversal of fortunes has painted Putin into a corner, transforming him into what analysts describe as a "drowning man" — unpredictable and potentially dangerous. His initial misjudgment of Ukrainian resolve and Western unity has not only prolonged the war but has also deepened Russia's internal and external crises. Sanctions continue to bite, domestic dissent, though suppressed, simmers, and the global perception of Russia has plummeted to historic lows. The grandiose vision of a swift victory and a resurgent Russian sphere of influence has evaporated, replaced by the grim specter of prolonged attrition.

The international community watches with bated breath, recognizing the inherent dangers of a cornered autocrat. As the pressure mounts, the Kremlin's calculus could shift towards increasingly risky and unconventional tactics, both within the conflict zone and on the broader geopolitical stage. The "drowning man" analogy serves as a stark warning: desperation can lead to erratic behavior, making the next phases of this ongoing crisis deeply uncertain and potentially escalatory for everyone involved.

Ultimately, the enduring conflict in Ukraine stands as a monumental testament to strategic hubris. It has not only redefined modern warfare but has also ushered in an era where the unraveling of a once-powerful leader’s carefully constructed narrative threatens to destabilize an already fractured world order for years to come.
keyTakeaways: Russia's 'special military operation' in Ukraine, intended for a quick victory, has become a prolonged and costly strategic failure.
President Putin's increasingly desperate position could lead to unpredictable and potentially dangerous escalations, impacting global stability.
The conflict has dramatically damaged Russia's international standing and military reputation, revealing a significant miscalculation of geopolitical realities.
author: Foreign Policy
